questions.cardText:
[Mathematics] What is the term for a number that can NOT be expressed as a fraction of two integers?
A. Irrational number
B. Complex number
C. Composite number
Answer: A.
questions.de: Wie nennt man eine reelle Zahl, die sich nicht als Bruch zweier ganzer Zahlen darstellen lässt?
questions.en: What is the term for a real number that cannot be expressed as a fraction of two integers?

timeline.labelEn: A Pythagorean, possibly Hippasus of Metapontum, first proves that irrational numbers exist
timeline.labelDe: Ein Pythagoreer, möglicherweise Hippasos von Metapont, beweist erstmals die Existenz irrationaler Zahlen

questions.notes: 'Real' added: non-real complex numbers are not fractions of integers either.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How are grasshoppers and locusts different?
A. They are the same species behaving differently
B. They are completely different species
C. One is nocturnal, while the other diurnal
Answer: A. Grasshoppers and locusts are the same species, but some grasshoppers can transform into locusts when environmental conditions such as high population density and food availability trigger physical changes, leading to swarming behavior.
questions.de: Was werden bestimmte Arten von Kurzfühlerschrecken, wenn eine hohe Populationsdichte körperliche und Verhaltensänderungen auslöst, die sie zum Schwärmen bringen?
questions.en: What do certain species of short-horned grasshoppers become when high population density triggers physical and behavioural changes that lead them to swarm?

timeline.labelEn: Boris Uvarov, entomologist and father of locust phase theory
timeline.labelDe: Boris Uwarow, Entomologe und Begründer der Phasentheorie der Wanderheuschrecken

questions.notes: Card oversimplifies: locusts are not one species with grasshoppers in general — only certain grasshopper species have a gregarious (swarming) phase; no taxonomic distinction separates locust and grasshopper species (Wikipedia). Uvarov dates from his article.
